features: Rugged, Anti-Slip Body: Designed for everyday comfort and durability, the Apex PB400 features a rugged anti-slip body with a premium soft-touch finish that offers a secure, comfortable grip. Whether you're commuting, travelling, or working on the go, the textured finish helps reduce accidental slips while adding a refined in-hand feel.

20000mAh Massive Battery: Stay powered through long workdays, travel, and everyday adventures with the 20000mAh high-capacity Li-ion polymer battery. Designed with smart power management, it delivers reliable backup power for smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and other USB-powered devices while maintaining long-term battery efficiency.

22.5W 2-Way Wired Fast Charging: Charge compatible devices quickly with 22.5W fast charging, while also recharging the power bank efficiently. Supporting QC 3.0, Power Delivery (PD), and PPS fast-charging protocols, the Apex PB400 helps reduce charging time and keeps you ready when every minute counts.

Built-in Type-C 2-Way Charging Cable: The integrated 2-Way Type-C charging cable zeros the need to carry an additional cable. It supports both charging your devices and recharging the power bank, making it a convenient companion for commuting, work, and travel.

Dual Input & Triple Output: Recharge the power bank through the Type-C 2-Way port or the built-in Type-C cable, and charge up to three compatible devices simultaneously using the Type-C port, built-in Type-C cable, and USB-A port.

Pass-Through Charging: Recharge the power bank while simultaneously charging connected devices using the pass-through charging feature. This convenient functionality helps maintain a cleaner charging setup and keeps your devices powered without waiting for the power bank to recharge first.

12-Layer Smart IC Protection: The advanced 12-layer Smart IC protection system safeguards against short circuits, overcharging, over-discharging, overcurrent, and other electrical abnormalities. Charge your devices confidently with enhanced safety for both the power bank and connected devices.

LED Battery Indicators with Fast Charging Status: The LED battery indicators clearly display the remaining battery level, while the dedicated green fast-charging indicator confirms when QC 3.0, Power Delivery (PD), or PPS fast charging is active, allowing you to monitor charging status easily.

High Temperature & Scratch Resistant: Built to withstand everyday wear, the Apex PB400 features a high-temperature and scratch-resistant exterior that helps protect the power bank from minor scuffs, scratches, and heat exposure during regular use. Its durable construction is designed to maintain a premium appearance and reliable performance over time.

Compact & Travel-Friendly: Despite its 20000mAh capacity, the Apex PB400 maintains a compact, travel-friendly form factor that fits comfortably into backpacks, handbags, or luggage, making it a dependable power companion wherever you go.
